interpretation: Historical crop availability and selection repair. Subsidiary agriculture is possible within a predominantly non-cropping ecological polygon. No population, rank or location identifiers enter these assignments; land and shared water limits still apply.

crop_systems.name: Northwestern Indian summer and winter cereals
Saharan and Arabian conditional oasis cereals

limitations: Crop availability is historical evidence; transferring regional preferences to each ecoregion is inferred.
Oasis crops require positive local modeled yield and actual land/water opportunity; listing wheat does not irrigate a desert.
No modern crop, groundwater or unlimited water storage is introduced.

water_response.analogue: Rye uses small-grain coefficients; millets use sorghum. Other crops retain reference demand. Four equal-duration stage bins are an approximation.
water_response.interpretation: Seasonal delivered irrigation fraction with 25% weight on worst-month satisfaction. This is a transparent conservative screening prior, not FAO Ky or simulated daily crop growth. Output served hectares are full-demand-equivalent productive hectares; not a survey of watered acreage. No extra withdrawals or stored water.
